'''Albanian vegetable pie''' (Albanian: '''''Byrek Shqipëtar me perime'''''), is an [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Albania|Albania]]n recipe for cooking pies. Albanian pies are generally made of thin pastry leaves which can be rolled out at home or bought as [[Cookbook:Phyllo Dough|filo dough]] at a supermarket. Most of the pies prepared by Albanian cooks are not sweet; instead, pie fillings are almost always savory. Thus, a piece of such a pie may well serve as the main dish of a meal.

== Ingredients ==
Serves 4–6:
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]], preferably [[Cookbook:Olive_Oil|olive oil]]
*1½ packets (or about 30 [[Cookbook:Each|ea.]]) [[Cookbook:Phyllo Dough|filo]] pastry leaves
*1½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (680 [[Cookbook:g|g]]) [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 cup (240 ml) [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Feta Cheese|feta cheese]]
*½ cup (120 ml) chopped [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]]
*2–3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (7.5 ml) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] a medium-sized baking pan with some of the oil, and start layering the pastry leaves inside. First, lay two leaves, sprinkle or brush with oil, then lay two more leaves, and repeat the procedure until half of the leaves are in place. Make sure that they cover the pan by hanging them about one inch over the edges of the pan.
# Sprinkle spinach with salt, then mix well by hand. Add the feta cheese, oil, onions, eggs and salt, and spread this mixture over the already laid pastry leaves. Finish by covering the spinach with the rest of the pastry leaves, repeating the first-half procedure.
# Roll the hanging edges of the bottom leaves over the pie (think of a [[Cookbook:Pizza|pizza]] crust).
# Sprinkle top with oil and bake moderately at [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|350°F (175°C)]] for about 45 minutes, or until golden brown.
# Serve hot, accompanied with [[Cookbook:Buttermilk|buttermilk]], or beaten [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]], thinned down in cold water or with chilled [[Cookbook:Stewed Prunes|stewed prunes]]. Sometimes a green [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]] adds to the meal!

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* A medium-sized, round baking pan is recommended because it's more authentic, but any medium-sized baking pan will do.
